1: Tomato Alfredo Chicken with Spinach
4 servings
chicken breast: 525 g (2-3 fillets)
basil pasta tomato sauce: 360 g (1 jar)
cream 10%: 240 ml (1 cup)
cream cheese or 5% cottage cheese: 160 g
durum pasta (rigatoni, penne): 225 g dry
light cheese, grated: 100 g (3 matchbox-sized pieces)
spinach (fresh or frozen): 75 g (2 handfuls)
milk 1.5%: 50 ml (3 tbsp)
dried garlic and onion, pepper, paprika, Provençal herbs, parsley, dill, salt
[[5 min]] Prep everything first: measure the sauce, cream and cream cheese, mix the spices in a small bowl. If the spinach is frozen, take it out to thaw.

[[2 min]] Put the whole chicken breasts on the bottom of a heavy pot or deep pan. Pour the tomato sauce and cream over them, add the cream cheese and all the spices, and stir the sauce around the chicken.

[[40–50 min]] Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, then turn the heat to low, cover and simmer. Stir every 10–15 minutes so the sauce doesn't catch. The chicken is done when it pulls apart easily with a fork.
[[10 min]] While the chicken simmers, boil the pasta in salted water 1–2 minutes less than the package says. Drain, don't rinse.
[[3 min]] Shred the chicken with two forks right in the pot and stir it into the sauce.
[[5 min]] Add the spinach and heat for 5 minutes, stirring: the leaves should just wilt. If added earlier, the spinach turns mushy.
[[2 min]] Stir in the pasta and pour in the milk, mix until creamy. Stir half the cheese into the pasta.
[[15 min]] Sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top, take off the heat and leave covered for 15 minutes: the cheese melts and the pasta soaks up the sauce.
[[3 min]] Divide among 4 containers, let cool with the lids off and refrigerate.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
2: Beef Pasta with Peppers and Two Cheeses
pasta (shells or any durum): 225 g dry
Italian herbs, smoked paprika, chili flakes, dried garlic, pepper, salt
[[5 min]] Put water on for the pasta. Seed the peppers and cut into large pieces, cut the tomatoes into wedges, finely chop the garlic.

[[8–10 min]] Heat a dry pan over high heat. Add the peppers and tomatoes, sprinkle with some of the spices and fry, stirring, until the pepper edges darken and the tomatoes release juice. Add the garlic for the last minute. Transfer the vegetables to a bowl.
[[8–10 min]] Boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.

[[8–10 min]] While the pasta cooks, put the mince in the same pan. Break up lumps with a spatula, add the remaining spices and fry over high heat until the liquid evaporates and the meat starts to brown.
[[3 min]] Return the vegetables to the mince, add the processed cheese and grated light cheese. Stir over medium heat until the cheeses melt into a sauce.
[[2 min]] Stir in the pasta, taste and add salt. Divide among 4 containers.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir. Add a spoon of milk on top before reheating.
Calories and protein are estimated from the ingredients; the author did not show them.
3: pasta (fettuccine or any durum): 220 g dry
dried garlic, Italian herbs, smoked paprika, pepper, salt
[[5 min]] Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Pat the chicken dry and rub on all sides with paprika, garlic, salt and pepper.
[[20–25 min]] Place the breasts in a dish and bake. Check the thickest part with a cut: the juice runs clear and the meat is white.
[[10 min]] While the chicken bakes, hard-boil the eggs: 10 minutes in boiling water, then into cold water, then peel.
[[8–10 min]] At the same time boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain and let cool for 5 minutes.
[[3 min]] Sauce: put the cottage cheese, boiled eggs, grated cheese, milk, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper in a blender. Blend into a smooth creamy sauce.
[[2 min]] Stir the sauce into the slightly cooled pasta. Don't heat the sauce on the stove or the cottage cheese will curdle.
[[3 min]] Let the chicken rest 5 minutes after the oven, then slice into strips. Divide among containers: pasta in sauce, chicken on top.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
4: Beef, Bacon and Sweet Pepper Pasta
bacon (any smoked, turkey is fine): 140 g
fusilli or any durum pasta: 180 g dry
sauce: Greek yogurt 350 g, milk 200 ml, light cheese 90 g, cream or processed cheese 20-40 g, Parmesan or hard cheese 20 g, honey 12 g (2 tsp), pepper
[[5 min]] Put water on for the pasta. Cut the peppers and onion into large pieces.
[[5 min]] Fry the peppers and onion in a hot pan over high heat, season with salt and pepper, until the edges brown.
[[8 min]] Add the mince to the vegetables, break up lumps with a spatula and fry until all the liquid is gone.
[[5–6 min]] Meanwhile fry the chopped bacon in a separate pan until crisp. Add it to the mince together with the rendered fat.
[[10 min]] Cook the pasta al dente according to the package and drain.
[[3 min]] Sauce: whisk the yogurt, milk, honey and pepper in a bowl. Stir in the grated cheeses. No blender needed.
[[3–4 min]] Combine the pasta, mince with vegetables and sauce in a pot. Warm over low heat, stirring constantly, until hot, but don't let it boil or the yogurt will curdle.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir. From frozen: 1.5 minutes, stir, another 45 seconds.
5: Baked Chicken Pasta with Caramelized Onion
4 servings (or 5 at 453 kcal)
chicken breast: 650 g (seasoning: 1 tsp each of paprika, garlic and onion powder, oregano, salt, pepper and ½ tsp chili)
vegetable oil: 1 tbsp
onion: 1 large or 2 medium, in half rings (with a pinch of paprika, salt and Italian herbs)
garlic: 2 small heads (cut off the tops)
sun-dried tomatoes: 2 tbsp (or 1 tbsp tomato paste)
cream 10% (instead of light condensed milk): 250 ml
light cream cheese: 150 g
Parmesan or hard cheese: 3 tbsp
parsley: 2 tbsp
fusilli: 300 g dry, ½ lemon
[[5 min]] Preheat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Mix the chicken spices. Slice the onion into half-rings and cut the tops off the garlic bulbs.
[[3 min]] Put the chicken, onion and garlic in a large dish. Drizzle with oil, rub the chicken with the spices, sprinkle the onion with paprika, salt and herbs.
[[25–30 min]] Cover the dish with foil and bake. The chicken is done when the juice runs clear (75 °C inside). If not, return for 5–10 more minutes.
[[10 min]] While everything bakes, boil the pasta al dente and drain.
[[3 min]] Take the chicken out onto a board and shred with forks. Squeeze the garlic out of its skins.
[[10–20 min]] Add the sun-dried tomatoes to the onion in the dish and bake uncovered until the onion is soft and golden.
[[3 min]] Stir the cream, cream cheese, parmesan, mashed garlic and parsley into the warm dish to make a creamy sauce.
[[2 min]] Add the pasta and chicken, squeeze in the juice of half a lemon and mix. Divide among 4 containers.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
6: One-Dish Chicken, Rice and Broccoli Bake
basmati rice (or any long-grain), rinsed: 200 g dry (1 cup)
garlic and onion powder 1 tsp each, salt, pepper
[[5 min]] Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Rinse the rice in several changes of water until it runs clear. Cut the chicken into 2–3 cm cubes, break the broccoli into small florets.
[[3 min]] Dissolve the stock cube in 500 ml of hot water.
[[3 min]] In a large dish mix the raw rice, chicken, pesto, yogurt, broccoli, stock and spices. Level it so all the rice is under the liquid. Scatter the mozzarella on top.
[[45–55 min]] Seal the dish tightly with foil around the edges so no steam escapes, and bake. The rice should be soft and the liquid absorbed.
[[10–15 min]] Remove the foil and bake until the cheese is golden.
[[5 min]] Let stand 5 minutes and divide into 4 portions.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. About 5 g of fiber per serving.
7: Chicken Noodles with Vegetables in Asian Sauce
4 servings
chicken breast: 900 g
egg noodles (or any): 225 g
zucchini: 450 g (1 large)
mushrooms: 350 g
bell pepper: 200 g
carrot: 100 g, onion: 100 g, green onion: 20 g
sauce: soy 60 g, oyster sauce 40 g (substitute: more soy + a pinch of sugar), sriracha or hot sauce 15 g, garlic 12 g, ginger 10 g
cornstarch: 1 heaping tsp, dissolved in 50 ml cold water
for the chicken: smoked paprika, dried garlic and onion, black pepper, salt

[[5 min]] Prep the ingredients: cube the chicken, cut the mushrooms into large pieces, the carrot into matchsticks, the pepper and onion into strips, the zucchini into half-moons, finely chop the spring onion. Grate the garlic and ginger.
[[5 min]] Boil the noodles 1 minute less than the package says and rinse with cold water. This keeps them from going soggy over several days.
[[12–15 min]] Coat the chicken in the spices. Heat a dry pan and fry in batches for 6–8 minutes until browned, without crowding the pan. Transfer to a bowl.
[[5 min]] Put the mushrooms in the same pan and fry over high heat until the water evaporates.
[[7 min]] Add the carrot, after 2 minutes the pepper and onion, after another 2 minutes the zucchini. Fry 3–4 minutes: the vegetables should stay slightly crisp.
[[2 min]] Sauce: mix the soy and oyster sauces, sriracha, garlic and ginger. Stir the starch into 50 ml of cold water.
[[3 min]] Return the chicken to the vegetables, pour in the sauce and when it boils add the starch, stirring until the sauce thickens and turns glossy.
[[2 min]] Take off the heat and stir in the noodles. Divide among 4 containers, spring onion on top.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Calories and protein are estimated from the ingredients; the author did not show them.
8: Sweet and Sour Chicken with Fried Rice
sauce: sugar-free ketchup 75 g (4 tbsp), soy 40 g, honey 30 g (1.5 tbsp), sriracha 20 g, rice or apple vinegar 20 ml, garlic 10 g
soy sauce for the rice: 25 g, cornstarch 1 tsp, green onion 20 g, chicken spices

[[25 min]] Cover the rice with water (1 cup of rice to 2¼ cups of water), bring to a boil and cook covered over low heat for 20–25 minutes. Spread in a thin layer on a plate and cool: hot rice sticks together in the pan.
[[5 min]] While the rice cooks, cube the chicken and cut the pepper and onion into large pieces. Grate the garlic.
[[12–15 min]] Coat the chicken in the spices and fry in a hot dry pan in batches for 6–8 minutes until browned. Set aside.
[[3–4 min]] In the same pan fry the pepper and onion over high heat: they should stay crisp inside.
[[3 min]] Sauce: mix the ketchup, soy sauce, honey, sriracha, vinegar and garlic and bring to a boil. Stir the starch into 50 ml of cold water and pour into the sauce, stirring until thick.
[[2–3 min]] Return the chicken to the pepper, pour in the sauce and heat until glossy.
[[8 min]] In a clean pan heat the frozen vegetable mix for 5 minutes. Push it to the side, pour in the eggs and stir into a scramble. Add the cold rice and soy sauce and fry for 3 minutes.
[[2 min]] Divide among containers: rice with vegetables and egg, chicken in sauce and spring onion on top.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Calories and protein are estimated from the ingredients; the author did not show them.
9: 4 servings (440 kcal each per the author)
baking powder: 4 g (1 level tsp, makes the chicken more tender)
fresh orange juice: 60 ml, soy sauce: 100 g, black pepper: 2 g, cornstarch: 12 g (1 tbsp)
sauce: garlic 6 g, ginger 6 g, sugar-free orange juice 160 ml, soy 60 g, rice or apple vinegar 24 g, sugar 14 g (3 tsp, or sweetener)
optional: orange zest, a pinch of chili flakes, 1 tsp oil
to serve: sesame, green onion, cooked rice: 320 g for all 4 servings (80 g per serving per the author; more rice means more calories)
[[5 min]] Cut the chicken into 2–3 cm cubes. Mix with the baking powder, orange juice, soy sauce, pepper and starch.
[[15–20 min]] Leave to marinate. Meanwhile cook the rice if it isn't ready yet.
[[3 min]] Sauce: grate the garlic and ginger, mix with the orange juice, soy sauce, vinegar and sugar. Add zest and chili if you like.
[[8–10 min]] Heat a spoon of oil in a pan over high heat and fry the chicken in a single layer, in batches, until browned on all sides. Transfer to a bowl.
[[4–5 min]] Pour the sauce into the same pan and reduce over medium heat until it thickens to a syrup.
[[2 min]] Return the chicken and stir until every piece is coated in glossy sauce.
[[2 min]] Divide the rice among 4 plates or containers, chicken on top. Sprinkle with sesame and spring onion.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
10: [[3 min]] In a bowl beat the eggs with the cottage cheese using a fork or blender until smooth. Add the grated cheese, chopped herbs, salt and pepper.
[[1 min]] Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.

[[8–10 min]] Pour in the mixture, turn the heat to low and cover. The omelet is ready when the middle is no longer runny and has puffed up. Without a pan: in a greased dish in the microwave for 3–4 minutes.
[[1 min]] Fold in half and slide onto a plate.
11: vanilla protein powder: ½ scoop (15 g), without it: a spoon of milk powder or just more yogurt
sweetener or honey: 1 tbsp, vanilla ¼ tsp, cinnamon ¼ tsp
filling: fat-free Greek yogurt 85 g (⅓ cup), protein 15 g, a splash of milk, cinnamon
[[3 min]] In a wide bowl whisk the egg with the milk, protein, sweetener, vanilla and cinnamon until smooth, with no lumps.
[[1 min]] Dip the bread slices on both sides and hold for 10–15 seconds so they soak through.
[[4 min]] Heat a pan over medium heat and grease with oil or spray. Fry 1–2 minutes per side until golden.
[[2 min]] Filling: mix the yogurt with the protein. If too thick, add a little milk.
[[1 min]] Assemble: a slice, a layer of filling, a pinch of cinnamon, the next slice. More cinnamon on top.
12: Baked Oatmeal Carrot Cake
8 pieces
ripe bananas: 3 (mashed)
eggs: 2
milk: 180 ml (¾ cup)
Greek yogurt: 120 g
rolled oats: 180 g (2 cups)
vanilla protein powder: 60 g (without it use finely ground oats and add more frosting)
grated carrot: 100 g (1 medium)
walnuts or pecans: 60 g
honey: 2 tbsp, cinnamon 1 tsp, ginger and nutmeg ¼ tsp each, baking powder 1 tsp, pinch of salt
frosting: cottage cheese 225 g, Greek yogurt 30 g, honey 2 tbsp, vanilla, cinnamon
[[5 min]] Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Line a 20 × 20 cm dish with baking paper. Grate the carrot and roughly chop the nuts.
[[5 min]] In a bowl mash the bananas, stir in the eggs, milk, yogurt and honey.
[[3 min]] Add the oats, protein, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, baking powder and salt, then the carrot and nuts. Mix and pour into the dish.
[[30–35 min]] Bake until golden. A toothpick in the center should come out dry.
[[3 min]] While it bakes, blend the cottage cheese, yogurt, honey, vanilla and cinnamon into a smooth cream.
[[30 min]] Let the oatmeal cool completely or the cream will run.
[[3 min]] Spread the cream on top and cut into 8 pieces.
Keeps in the fridge 3-4 days.
13: Cottage Cheese Semolina Cake with Cherry Jam
batter: soft 0.1% cottage cheese 200 g, semolina 50 g, 1 egg yolk, 3 egg whites, baking powder 4 g (1 tsp), milk 60 ml, sweetener to taste
jam: frozen cherries 150 g, cornstarch 4 g (½ tsp), sweetener to taste
[[5 min]] Separate 1 yolk from the whites. Mix the cottage cheese, semolina, yolk, milk and sweetener. Don't add the whites and baking powder yet.
[[30 min]] Leave the batter so the semolina swells. Near the end preheat the oven to 160 °C.
[[4 min]] Whisk the 3 whites to stiff peaks. Stir the baking powder into the batter, then gently fold in the whites with a spatula in 2–3 additions.
[[30 min]] Pour into a small tin and bake.
[[15 min]] Turn off the oven and open the door slightly; let the cake cool gradually so it doesn't sink.

[[5 min]] Compote: put the cherries in a pan over medium heat and wait until they release juice. Stir the starch into 30 ml of water. Add the sweetener, pour in the starch and stir for about a minute until it sets like jelly.
[[2 min]] Pour the compote over the cake. Eat right away or refrigerate overnight.
The author counted macros for the whole pan, so divide by two for half.
14: Protein Cheesecake Bowl with Passion Fruit
vanilla protein yogurt: 160 g (substitute: Greek yogurt + 1 tsp honey + a drop of vanilla)
passion fruit pulp: 30 ml (substitute: puree of kiwi, raspberry or another tart berry)
plain dry biscuits without sugar: 4 (substitute: any dry biscuit)
maple syrup: 20 ml (substitute: 1 tsp honey or sweetener)
[[2 min]] Mix the yogurt with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
[[3 min]] Line a sieve with cheesecloth or a clean thin towel and set it over a bowl. Add the yogurt, cover and press down with a small plate or cup.
[[24 h]] Refrigerate. The whey drains off and the yogurt becomes as thick as cream cheese.
[[1 min]] Squeeze the mass lightly and transfer to a bowl.
[[3 min]] Crumble the cookies. Layer in a glass or bowl: cookies, cream, passion fruit pulp. Drizzle maple syrup on top.
15: hot honey: 40 g, ours: 2 tbsp honey + 1 tsp hot sauce (sriracha, chili)
Dijon or whole-grain mustard: 15 g (1 tbsp)
garlic powder and smoked paprika ½ tsp each, salt, pepper
[[2 min]] Put all the ingredients in a blender or the cup of a stick blender: yogurt, mayonnaise, honey with hot sauce, mustard, vinegar, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper.
[[1 min]] Blend into a smooth creamy sauce.
[[1 min]] Taste: add honey for sweetness, hot sauce for heat or vinegar for tang.
[[30 min]] Pour into a bottle or container and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes so the flavor develops.
Keep refrigerated in a closed container.
16: Chicken Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Rice
tomato passata or crushed canned tomatoes: 500 g (2 cups)
garlic 2 cloves, salt, pepper, dried basil or oregano
[[20 min]] Rinse the rice and cook according to the package. Make the meatballs in the meantime.
[[5 min]] Chop the onion as finely as possible and crush the garlic. Mix the mince with the oats, egg, onion, salt and pepper. Let stand 5 minutes so the oats swell.
[[5 min]] With wet hands shape 30–35 g balls, walnut-sized. You'll get about 20.
[[5 min]] Heat the oil in a deep pan over medium heat and brown the meatballs on all sides. They're still raw inside, that's fine.
[[15 min]] Pour in the tomatoes, add the garlic, basil or oregano and salt. Bring to a boil, lower the heat, cover and simmer. The meatballs are done when there's no pink inside.
[[2 min]] Divide the rice and meatballs with sauce among 4 containers.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
17: Beef Chili con Carne with Rice
4 servings
lean ground beef: 500 g
onion: 150 g (1 large)
bell pepper: 200 g (1 large)
tomato passata or canned tomatoes: 400 g (1.5 cups)
canned red beans, drained: 240 g (1 can)
canned corn: 150 g (half a can)
dry rice: 160 g (¾ cup)
oil: 10 g (2 tsp)
spices: paprika 2 tsp, cumin 1 tsp, ground chili to taste, garlic 3 cloves, salt
[[5 min]] Dice the onion and pepper, finely chop the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans, drain the corn.
[[15 min]] Put the rice on to cook according to the package.
[[5 min]] Heat the oil in a deep pan or pot and fry the onion and pepper over medium heat until soft.
[[1 min]] Add the garlic, paprika, cumin and chili and stir for a minute until fragrant.
[[5–7 min]] Add the mince, break up lumps with a spatula and fry until the meat has completely changed color.
[[25 min]] Pour in the tomatoes, add the beans and corn, season with salt. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over low heat, stirring every 10 minutes. If it gets too thick, add a little water.
[[2 min]] Serve with the rice, with a spoon of yogurt and herbs on top if you like.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
If you have no red beans, any canned beans work. Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
18: Chicken Curry with Chickpeas and Rice
light coconut milk (substitute: 2.5% milk + 1 tsp oil): 200 g (¾ cup)
curry powder 1.5 tbsp, grated ginger and garlic 2 tsp each, salt, herbs
[[15 min]] Put the rice on to cook according to the package.
[[5 min]] Cut the chicken into 2–3 cm cubes, finely chop the onion, grate the ginger and garlic. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
[[4 min]] Heat the oil in a deep pan and fry the onion over medium heat until soft.
[[1 min]] Add the ginger, garlic and curry powder and stir for a minute so the spices open up.
[[5 min]] Add the chicken and fry, stirring, until it turns white on all sides.
[[15 min]] Pour in the passata and coconut milk, add the chickpeas and salt. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over low heat until the sauce thickens.
[[2 min]] Divide the rice and curry among containers, herbs on top.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
No coconut milk: use milk and a bit more tomato, the flavor will be lighter. Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
19: tuna in its own juice, drained: 360 g (3 small cans)
garlic 2 cloves, chili, salt, pepper, parsley
[[10 min]] Put water on, salt it and boil the pasta 1 minute less than the instructions. Before draining, save half a cup of the cooking water.
[[3 min]] While the pasta cooks, finely chop the onion and garlic and slice the olives. Drain the tuna and flake it with a fork.
[[4 min]] Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onion and garlic over medium heat until translucent.
[[8 min]] Pour in the passata, add chili, salt and pepper. Simmer over low heat until the sauce thickens.
[[3 min]] Add the tuna and olives and heat through, stirring.
[[2 min]] Toss the pasta with the sauce and 2–3 spoons of cooking water so the sauce coats it. Divide among containers, grated cheese and parsley on top.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
20: Greek yogurt for the sauce: 160 g (⅔ cup)
paprika, cumin, garlic, lime or lemon, salt, pepper
